name: 94 - Core - Record Operational Event and Workflow Error - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS event_kind,
        NULLIF($2::BIGINT, 0) AS requested_clinic_id,
        NULLIF($3::TEXT, '') AS clinic_name,
        $4::TEXT AS actor_type,
        NULLIF($5::TEXT, '') AS actor_name,
        $6::TEXT AS event_category,
        $7::TEXT AS event_action,
        NULLIF($8::TEXT, '') AS entity_type,
        NULLIF($9::BIGINT, 0) AS entity_id,
        NULLIF($10::TEXT, '') AS workflow_name,
        NULLIF($11::TEXT, '') AS workflow_id,
        NULLIF($12::TEXT, '') AS execution_id,
        NULLIF($13::TEXT, '') AS node_name,
        $14::TEXT AS severity,
        $15::BOOLEAN AS success,
        NULLIF($16::TEXT, '') AS source_channel,
        NULLIF($17::TEXT, '') AS request_reference,
        $18::JSONB AS event_data,
        $19::TEXT AS error_fingerprint,
        NULLIF($20::TEXT, '') AS error_type,
        NULLIF($21::TEXT, '') AS error_message,
        NULLIF($22::TEXT, '') AS stack_trace,
        $23::BOOLEAN AS retryable,
        $24::JSONB AS input_snapshot,
        $25::JSONB AS error_payload
),

resolved_context AS (
    SELECT
        request.*,
        COALESCE(
            request.requested_clinic_id,
            clinic_by_name.id
        ) AS clinic_id
    FROM request_data request
    LEFT JOIN clinics clinic_by_name
        ON clinic_by_name.name =
           request.clinic_name
       AND clinic_by_name.is_active = TRUE
),

inserted_audit AS (
    INSERT INTO system_audit_events (
        clinic_id,
        actor_type,
        actor_name,
        event_category,
        event_action,
        entity_type,
        entity_id,
        workflow_name,
        workflow_id,
        execution_id,
        severity,
        success,
        source_channel,
        request_reference,
        event_data
    )
    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        context.actor_type,
        context.actor_name,
        context.event_category,
        context.event_action,
        context.entity_type,
        context.entity_id,
        context.workflow_name,
        context.workflow_id,
        context.execution_id,
        context.severity,
        context.success,
        context.source_channel,
        context.request_reference,
        context.event_data
    FROM resolved_context context
    WHERE context.event_kind = 'audit'
    RETURNING id
),

upserted_error AS (
    INSERT INTO workflow_error_events (
        clinic_id,
        error_fingerprint,
        workflow_name,
        workflow_id,
        execution_id,
        node_name,
        error_type,
        error_message,
        stack_trace,
        severity,
        retryable,
        status,
        input_snapshot,
        error_payload,
        first_occurred_at,
        last_occurred_at,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        context.error_fingerprint,
        context.workflow_name,
        context.workflow_id,
        context.execution_id,
        context.node_name,
        context.error_type,
        context.error_message,
        context.stack_trace,
        context.severity,
        context.retryable,
        'open',
        context.input_snapshot,
        context.error_payload,
        NOW(),
        NOW(),
        NOW()
    FROM resolved_context context
    WHERE context.event_kind = 'error'
    ON CONFLICT (error_fingerprint)
    DO UPDATE SET
        clinic_id = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.clinic_id,
            workflow_error_events.clinic_id
        ),
        workflow_name = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.workflow_name,
            workflow_error_events.workflow_name
        ),
        workflow_id = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.workflow_id,
            workflow_error_events.workflow_id
        ),
        execution_id = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.execution_id,
            workflow_error_events.execution_id
        ),
        node_name = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.node_name,
            workflow_error_events.node_name
        ),
        error_type = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.error_type,
            workflow_error_events.error_type
        ),
        error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message,
        stack_trace = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.stack_trace,
            workflow_error_events.stack_trace
        ),
        severity = EXCLUDED.severity,
        retryable = EXCLUDED.retryable,
        status = 'open',
        occurrence_count =
            workflow_error_events.occurrence_count + 1,
        input_snapshot = EXCLUDED.input_snapshot,
        error_payload = EXCLUDED.error_payload,
        last_occurred_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING
        id,
        occurrence_count
)

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN request.event_kind = 'error'
            THEN 'workflow_error_recorded'
        ELSE 'audit_event_recorded'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM inserted_audit
    ) AS audit_event_id,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM upserted_error
    ) AS workflow_error_event_id,

    (
        SELECT occurrence_count
        FROM upserted_error
    ) AS occurrence_count,

    request.error_fingerprint

FROM request_data request;

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{success:false,result:'invalid_request',message:'اطلاعات Audit یا Error Event نامعتبر است.',errors:$json.errors||[]}}];

parameters.content:
## Error Workflow مرکزی

این Workflow را می‌توان در تنظیمات n8n به‌عنوان Error Workflow انتخاب کرد.

خطاهای تکراری با fingerprint تجمیع می‌شوند و occurrence_count افزایش پیدا می‌کند.

Webhook برای ثبت Auditهای عمومی نیز قابل استفاده است.
